question: What will be the closing value of Apple (AAPL) stock (AAPL on Yahoo Finance) on September 17, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the daily close of AAPL on Yahoo Finance for 2026-09-17. If there is no close on that date (weekend or holiday), the last close before it is used.
research:
I couldn't open any page directly. Every fetch, including Yahoo Finance, was refused by the proxy, so all figures below come from search-result summaries. Several searches also returned material dated after 2026-09-10. Per your rules, I left that out entirely.

## 1. Resolution source
- The deciding figure is the Yahoo Finance AAPL daily close for 2026-09-17, a Thursday and a normal trading day. I could not load the [Yahoo history page](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/AAPL/history/).
- 2026-09-09: latest confirmed close was **$315.34** (open 315.49, high 319.15, low 309.90, down 0.28%). This comes from one aggregator and I couldn't confirm it with a second source. [stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/aapl/history/)
- 2026-09-10: markets will still be open when forecasts close at 18:00 UTC (2 p.m. ET), so today's close won't be known by then.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has happened yet that settles the question. There are five trading sessions between the 9-10 close and the 9-17 close.
- The last close, about $315, sits in the lower-middle of the 270-350 range.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-10: a Yahoo/Motley Fool analysis put the stock at about $315 after the event. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/prediction-apple-stock-could-headed-123003066.html)
- 2026-09-09: Apple held its fall event, announcing the foldable "iPhone Duo", iPhone 18 Pro and new watches. The iPhone 18 Pro starts at $1,199, $100 more than the iPhone 17 Pro. The stock was down for almost the whole presentation and about 1% lower that afternoon. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/09/apple-event-today-live-updates.html), [Yahoo live](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/live/apple-event-live-iphone-duo-iphone-18-pro--watches-announced-122840434.html)
- 2026-09-09: Simply Wall St called Apple about 26% overvalued after the event. [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/us/tech/nasdaq-aapl/apple/news/apple-aapl-could-be-26-overvalued-following-its-september-9)
- 2026-09-07: KeyBanc called the event "likely a negative catalyst for shares". It said Apple has fallen an average of 0.72% on announcement day over the past five years. [MacRumors](https://www.macrumors.com/2026/09/07/iphone-18-pro-event-could-hit-apple-shares/)
- 2026-09-07: AAPL fell 2.5% ahead of the launch. [Vantage](https://www.vantagemarkets.com/market-analysis/aapl-stock-price-today-iphone-launch-analyst-reaction-september-7-2026/)

## 4. Base rates and recent values
- Recent closes:
  - 2026-08-31: about $316.85 (another source says about $319.97). [stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/aapl/history/), [Yahoo SG](https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/quote/AAPL/history/?interval=1wk&filter=history&frequency=1wk&includeAdjustedClose=true)
  - 2026-09-02: $324.96 [stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/aapl/history/)
  - 2026-09-03: $328.21 [stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/aapl/history/)
  - 2026-09-09: $315.34 [stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/aapl/history/)
- The trend: August closes mostly ran about $305-320. The stock peaked near $328 on 9-3 and dropped about 4% into and through the event.
- My own rough volatility estimate (a calculation, not a sourced figure): AAPL usually moves about 1.3-1.8% a day, which works out to roughly 3-4% over five sessions, or about ±$10-13 at a $315 price. A ±2 standard deviation band would be roughly $290-340.
- Historical pattern: KeyBanc found the stock tends to dip on event day (average -0.72% over the past five years). I found no clean statistic for how it does in the week after.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-09-11 or 09-12: iPhone 18 Pro pre-orders were expected to open. MacRumors guessed Saturday 9-12 to avoid the 9-11 anniversary, but I found no official date. Early shipping wait times are a common signal for the stock. [MacRumors](https://www.macrumors.com/2026/09/04/iphone-18-pro-release-date-preorders/)
- 2026-09-15 to 09-16: Fed meeting, with the statement at 2:00 p.m. ET on the 16th, a press conference and updated projections. The current target range is 3.50-3.75%. ATFX says markets are weighing a hold against a 25 basis point hike. [Fed calendar](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/2026-september.htm), [ATFX](https://www.atfx.com/en-au/analysis/financial-events/september-fomc-meeting-2026-is-a-rate-hike-on-the-table)
- Mid-September: the August CPI report, which ATFX calls a key input for the Fed decision. I couldn't confirm its exact release date.
- 2026-09-18: expected iPhone release day and monthly options expiration. Both fall the day after resolution, but positioning ahead of them could affect trading on the 9-17 close.
